cb-01: ExecuteC is a method on *Command returning (*Command, error). In command.go:1052-1093 it initializes a missing context, redirects child calls to Root().ExecuteC(), runs the optional pre-execution hook, initializes help/completion commands and command groups, obtains arguments, and selects a command with Traverse or Find depending on TraverseChildren. Execute() delegates to ExecuteC and returns only its error (command.go:1038-1041); ExecuteContextC sets the context first (command.go:1046-1049).
cb-02: (*Command).MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive(flagNames ...string) is implemented in flag_groups.go:65-77. It merges persistent flags, looks up every supplied name, and appends the space-joined group names to each flag's mutuallyExclusive annotation. A missing flag or annotation-setting error causes a panic. Each call appends a separate group entry, allowing a flag to belong to multiple groups. ValidateFlagGroups collects these annotations for validation (flag_groups.go:79-97).
cb-03: GenMarkdownTree(cmd *cobra.Command, dir string) error delegates to GenMarkdownTreeCustom with an empty file prepender and an identity link handler (doc/md_docs.go:125-129). The custom function recursively processes available child commands, skips additional help topics, then creates the current command's file using its CommandPath with spaces replaced by underscores plus markdownExtension. It writes the prepender and generated Markdown, returning any creation or writing error (doc/md_docs.go:133-158).
cb-04: Use cmd.RegisterFlagCompletionFunc(flagName, callback), where callback has signature func(*Command, []string, string) ([]string, ShellCompDirective). It rejects nonexistent flags and duplicate registrations, then stores the callback under the flag pointer while holding a mutex (completions.go:132-146). GetFlagCompletionFunc retrieves it under a read lock (completions.go:148-161). The comment in shell_completions.go:52-53 says these Go completion functions work across all shells.
cb-07: flag_groups.go implements flag-group validation. ValidateFlagGroups skips validation when DisableFlagParsing is true and collects required-together, one-required, and mutually-exclusive annotations (lines 81-99). processFlagForGroupAnnotation considers a group only when all its flags are defined, using hasAllFlags (lines 111-134). validateRequiredFlagGroups permits all flags unset or all set; otherwise it sorts the missing names and returns an error requiring every group member to be set (lines 144-165).
cb-08: doc/man_docs.go contains man-page generation and header support: GenMan writes a command's man page to an io.Writer and permits a nil header (lines 103-106), while GenManTreeOptions holds tree-generation options (lines 82-86). fillHeader supplies an uppercase escaped title, default section "1", and a date from SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH or the current time, rejecting an invalid epoch. It formats the date as "Jan 2006" and supplies an autogenerated source unless disabled (lines 118-141).
cb-09: shell_completions.go provides flag helpers for shell completion. MarkFlagRequired delegates to the FlagSet helper and its documentation says the flag is prioritized in completion and required when invoking the command (lines 21-27). MarkPersistentFlagRequired documents the corresponding persistent-flag behavior (lines 29-30). MarkFlagFilename restricts completion to specified extensions, and MarkPersistentFlagFilename applies that helper to PersistentFlags() (lines 42-43 and 58-62).
cb-11: Required flags are checked by (*Command).ValidateRequiredFlags in command.go:1147-1168. Unless DisableFlagParsing is set, it visits the command's flags and collects those with BashCompOneRequiredFlag annotation "true" whose Changed field is false. It returns a required-flag error listing missing names, or nil if none are missing. The provided spans identify the validator but do not show its execution call site.
cb-12: INSUFFICIENT The response shows only the beginnings of Find and findNext, without the command-matching and argument-consumption logic needed to explain subcommand selection.
cb-13: SuggestionsFor checks each available child command and suggests its name if ld(typedName, cmd.Name(), true) is at most SuggestionsMinimumDistance or its lowercased name starts with the lowercased input. It also adds the command for case-insensitive matches against its explicit SuggestFor entries (command.go:832-849). findSuggestions returns nothing when DisableSuggestions is true, defaults a nonpositive distance to 2, and formats results under "Did you mean this?" (command.go:750-762).
cb-14: Shell scripts request completion through the hidden command described by ShellCompRequestCmd; ShellCompNoDescRequestCmd is the variant without descriptions (completions.go:27-31). The command's Run handler dispatches directly to cmd.getCompletions(args), which returns the final command, completions, directive, and error. Errors are reported with CompErrorln but processing continues so valid results and the directive can still be emitted. CalledAs() identifies the no-description variant (completions.go:202-217).
cb-15: INSUFFICIENT The response shows how InitDefaultVersionFlag creates the flag, but omits the code that handles a supplied version flag and produces version output.
cb-16: Levenshtein distance is computed by ld(s, t string, ignoreCase bool) int in cobra.go:187-213. The shown code optionally lowercases both strings and builds an integer matrix initialized with prefix lengths, then compares indexed characters and neighboring matrix cells. Command suggestions call ld(typedName, cmd.Name(), true) and compare the result to SuggestionsMinimumDistance (command.go:836-837).
cb-19: INSUFFICIENT The response omits the command-selection and execution connection and most Run-hook invocation code, so it cannot establish the full lifecycle from Execute through the hooks.
cb-20: Persistent flags propagate through mergePersistentFlags: it calls updateParentsPflags, then adds both the command's PersistentFlags() and the collected parentsPflags to c.Flags() (command.go:1849-1853). The updateParentsPflags comment explicitly says it adds new persistent flags from all parents and creates the collection if needed (command.go:1855-1863). LocalFlags triggers this merge; LocalNonPersistentFlags filters out persistent flags and is explicitly documented as not propagating to subcommands (command.go:1655-1670).
cb-21: Call parent.AddCommand(children...). AddCommand rejects adding a command as its own child, assigns each child's parent field to the receiver, updates maximum usage/path/name lengths, propagates any global normalization function, appends the child to c.commands, and marks the commands unsorted (command.go:1302-1329). The parent pointer is set by cmds[i].parent = c before the child is appended.
cb-22: The man-page generator walks child commands recursively: GenManTreeFromOpts loops over cmd.Commands(), skips unavailable commands and additional help topics, and calls itself on each remaining child, immediately returning any recursive error (doc/man_docs.go:48-61). This child traversal precedes the current command's section and separator setup (lines 62-69). The snippets also show Markdown and YAML tree generators starting loops over cmd.Commands() (doc/md_docs.go:133-134; doc/yaml_docs.go:60-61).
cb-24: INSUFFICIENT The response shows completion marking required-together group members as required, but omits how one-required and mutually-exclusive groups are enforced.
cb-25: Set cmd.CompletionOptions.DisableDefaultCmd = true before default completion initialization. The field is documented as preventing creation of the default completion command (completions.go:106-107), and InitDefaultCompletionCmd returns immediately when it is true (completions.go:683-686).
cb-26: Use <PROGRAM>_ACTIVE_HELP, with the root command name uppercased and non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters replaced by underscores. GetActiveHelpConfig reads this program-specific variable unless COBRA_ACTIVE_HELP is "0", which globally forces the result to "0" (active_help.go:46-62). The global variable's literal name is also defined at active_help.go:29.
cb-27: Set cobra.EnablePrefixMatching = true; the package variable is declared in cobra.go:55. During command lookup, exact name or alias matches win first; with prefix matching enabled, matching name/alias prefixes are collected, and a command is returned only if exactly one prefix match remains (command.go:770-785).
cb-28: INSUFFICIENT The response shows group-management methods and group IDs assigned to help/completion commands, but omits the GroupID field documentation and the behavior that uses command groups.
cb-30: Call doc.GenManTree(cmd, nil, dir) and handle its returned error; nil is allowed for the header. It generates pages for the command and its descendants in the specified directory (doc/man_docs.go:33-44). For options, use GenManTreeFromOpts with GenManTreeOptions; GenManTree itself passes Header, Path, and CommandSeparator "-". Hyphens in command names can create ambiguous filenames, as documented at lines 35-37.
cb-32: (*Command).Execute() error calls ExecuteC(), discards the returned command, and returns its error (command.go:1038-1041). Its documentation says it uses arguments, defaulting to os.Args[1:], to find matches through the command tree (command.go:1035-1036). ExecuteContext sets c.ctx before delegating to Execute (command.go:1030-1033).
cb-33: (*Command).Flags() returns the command's *flag.FlagSet, documented as covering local and persistent flags declared on the command and its parents. It lazily initializes c.flags with ContinueOnError and sends flag output to c.flagErrorBuf (command.go:1641-1653). LocalFlags is for flags declared on the current command, LocalNonPersistentFlags excludes persistent flags, and InheritedFlags first merges persistent flags (command.go:1655-1670 and 1696-1712).
cb-35: Completion support includes InitDefaultCompletionCmd, which adds a command for generating shell-completion scripts unless disabled, there are no subcommands, or a matching command or alias already exists (completions.go:683-709). Its Bash help gives the current-session command source <(PROGRAM completion bash) and requires bash-completion (completions.go:714-726). GenBashCompletion writes the preamble, optional BashCompletionFunction, generated completion body, and postscript to a writer (bash_completions.go:686-697).
ci-1133: On the currently executing command object, use cmd.Flag("flag-name") or cmd.Flags().Lookup("flag-name") to obtain the flag. Flag begins with exactly that lookup in command.go:1795-1798, and Flags returns a *flag.FlagSet (command.go:1643). The supplied snippet does not show a typed value getter.
ci-1222: For flag completion, write a callback with signature func(cmd *Command, args []string, toComplete string) ([]string, ShellCompDirective), and register it with cmd.RegisterFlagCompletionFunc("flag-name", callback). The implementation stores that callback for the named flag, returning an error if the flag does not exist or already has a registered callback (completions.go:132-146).
ci-1236: Use cmd.CalledAs() on the command you want to check. It returns the recorded invocation name when c.commandCalledAs.called is true, otherwise an empty string (command.go:1517-1522). Thus a nonempty result identifies a command recorded as called; the supplied excerpt does not show how to obtain the selected child from the root.
ci-1358: After defining the flags, call cmd.MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive("first", "second"). The method merges persistent flags, verifies that every named flag exists, and appends a mutuallyExclusive group annotation to each; unknown names panic (flag_groups.go:65-77). ValidateFlagGroups is documented as validating these groups (lines 79-86). During completion, selecting one member hides the others (lines 223-224).
ci-1408: Use the subcommand's cmd.Flag("name") or cmd.Flags().Lookup("name") for a global flag defined persistently on an ancestor. Flags is documented as the complete flag set including persistent flags declared by all parents (command.go:1641-1643), and Flag begins by looking up the name in that set (command.go:1795-1796). Local nonpersistent flags explicitly do not persist to subcommands (command.go:1655-1656).

The Version field documentation says a nonempty value enables an automatically added boolean --version flag that prints that value, and adds -v if available (command.go:108-112).
